_doc: Corpus-refresh offset registry — hb-133 (saturation-aware composite). Each entry records a one-time corpus rotation event and the composite-delta attributable to corpus shift alone (NOT decoder change). Subtract the cumulative sum of `offset_to_subtract` from any raw composite score computed against the post-refresh corpus to keep it comparable to the pre-refresh baseline. New entries are appended at corpus-refresh time; never edit historical entries. Anchored by `applies_from_sha` (the main HEAD just AFTER the refresh landed). See research/ideation/2026-06-01-metric.md (M5) and pancetta-research/src/metrics.rs::saturation_aware_composite.

offsets.note: hard-200 mix update (2026-05-30 corpus refresh). Computed as score(post-refresh main.json) - score(pre-refresh main.json) = 0.579114 - 0.569415 = +0.009699; same production decoder code (post-hb-068) on both sides, so the delta is purely corpus shift. Pre-refresh card archived at research/scorecards/history/main.2026-05-30-pre-refresh.json.

Task W0.2 synth-clean corpus refresh (2500 Hz SNR calibration + real sensitivity curve). Computed as score(post-refresh, synth-clean tier only) - score(pre-refresh, synth-clean tier only) = 0.1382143 - 0.15 = -0.011786; same production decoder (Ft8Config::default(), no changes in this task) on both sides, only the harness/corpus changed (noise-scaling formula recalibrated to the WSJT-X 2500 Hz reference bandwidth [+3.8 dB more noise per label], SNR@50% now genuine linear interpolation instead of first-bin->=-threshold, corpus regenerated at 1 dB steps / n=50 distinct messages per step / randomized base freq 400-2600 Hz + dt in [-0.3,+0.3] s, replacing the old 2 dB steps / n=6 / fixed-1500Hz-fixed-dt manifest), so the delta is purely corpus/harness shift, not decoder change. Pre-refresh single-tier scorecard was NOT archived to research/scorecards/history/ (ephemeral /tmp comparison only) since the pre-refresh corpus itself is regenerated non-deterministically-named per this task and superseded; the raw before/after composite numbers are recorded here and in research/experiments/2026-07-07-snr-calibration.md.
